fact: The ANINF was created by decree n°212/PR of 27 January 2011 and its listed missions include securing critical infrastructure and drawing up and running a national cybersecurity plan covering prevention, detection, incident response and recovery.
title: ANINF : Agence Nationale des Infrastructures Numérique et des Fréquences
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie Numérique, de la Digitalisation et de l'Innovation
